limitations: League-level period-template bootstrap; does not condition event generation on the requested team labels.
The event chronology is resampled from historical periods; this is not a learned next-event state machine.
No player identities, roster decisions, goalie ratings, continuous movement, puck possession, or physical causality are modeled.
A future viewer may display this event record but must label it hypothetical and must not imply a physical replay.

provenance.source: archived NHL GameCenter play-by-play with independent GameCenter boxscore validation
provenance.template_reuse_within_game: source game IDs are distinct across selected periods

summary.sog_event_count_definition: generated goal and shot-on-goal events in regulation/overtime
